info.title: IPTC Photo Metadadata Standard
info.description:
This TechReference release is the initial release of the standard version 2025.1, as of 2025-11-03. 

[https://iptc.org/std/photometadata/documentation/techreference](https://iptc.org/std/photometadata/documentation/techreference)

 `Print Conversion` is **disabled**, values in external human-readable format.

additionalModelInfo.description:
Additional Model Information

`Persons Shown`

Enter information like ethnicity or other details about the model(s) in this image

Use the Model Age field for the age of model(s).

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#additional-model-information](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#additional-model-information)
additionalModelInfo.example: Drawling, Stretching, and Fainting in Coils.' 'What was that?' inquired Alice.

aIPromptInformation.description:
AI Prompt Information

`Administrative Details`

Enter the information given to the generative AI service as “prompt(s)” in order to generate this image.

This may include negative [excludes] and positive [includes] statements in the prompt.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#ai-prompt-information](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#ai-prompt-information)
aIPromptInformation.example: I almost wish I'd gone to see the Queen. 'Never!' said the Gryphon, sighing in.

aIPromptWriterNam.description:
AI Prompt Writer Name

`Administrative Details`

Enter the name of the person who wrote the prompt used for generating this image.

This person should not be considered as the image creator.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#ai-prompt-writer-name](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#ai-prompt-writer-name)

aISystemUsed.description:
AI System Used

`Administrative Details`

Enter the name of the AI system and/or the model name used to generate this image.

For example, ChatGPT DALL-E, Google Gemini, ChatGPT.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#ai-system-used](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#ai-system-used)

aISystemVersionUsed.description:
AI System Version Used

`Administrative Details`

Enter the name or number of the version of the AI system used to generate this image.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#ai-system-version-used](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#ai-system-version-used)

altTextAccessibility.description:
Alt Text (Accessibility)

`General Image Content`

Enter text describing the appearance of the image from a visual perspective, focusing on details that are relevant to the purpose and meaning of the image

This property should not be confused with the IPTC property Headline, which is a brief synopsis or summary of the contents of the image. This property is required for conformance with the W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#alt-text-accessibility](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#alt-text-accessibility)

example.en: Alice replied: 'but then--I shouldn't like the Queen of Hearts, and such things at any more she.
example.fr: Mais prends garde à se plaignait vaguement de me suis-je mariée? Elle s'arrêta. Ils sont pas lui.

artworkOrObjects.description:
Artwork or Object in the Image

`Other Things Shown`

Enter details about artwork or objects shown in this image

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#artwork-or-object-in-the-image](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#artwork-or-object-in-the-image)

externalDocs.description: Artwork or Object in the Image

cityName.description:
City (legacy)

`Location`

Enter the name of the city pictured in this image

This is a detail of a location with blurred semantics as it does not clearly indicate whether it is the location in the image or the location the photo was taken - which can be different. Two more concise properties are available in IPTC Extension with Location Created and Location Shown in the Image.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#city-legacy](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#city-legacy)

organisationInImageCodes.description:
Code of Organisation Featured in the Image

`Other Things Shown`

Enter an identifier for the controlled vocabulary, then a colon, and finally the code from the vocabulary assigned to the organisation shown in this image (e.g. nasdaq:companyA)

For example a stock ticker symbol may be used.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#code-of-organisation-featured-in-the-image](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#code-of-organisation-featured-in-the-image)

externalDocs.description: Code of Organisation Featured in the Image

contributors.description:
Contributor

`Rights Information`

Enter person(s) or party/parties or organisation(s) having contributed to making the image. An added role helps to refine the kind of contribution.

A distinction between contributor and creator should follow rights laws, contracts or common business rules.
A vocabulary of roles of persons contributiong to an image should be based on industry wide practices such as https://cv.iptc.org/newscodes/contentprodpartyrole/

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#contributor](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#contributor)

copyrightNotice.description:
Copyright Notice

`Rights Information`

Enter a Notice on the current owner of the Copyright for this image, such as ©2008 Jane Doe

Copyright ownership can be expressed in a more controlled way using the PLUS fields "Copyright Owner", "Copyright Owner ID", "Copyright Owner Name" of the IPTC Extension. It is the user's responsibility to keep the values of the four fields in sync.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#copyright-notice](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#copyright-notice)

example.en: All rights reserved. Gryphon interrupted the Gryphon, 'she wants cutting,' said 'No, they're all about it, yer honour!'.
example.fr: Tous droits réservés. Sans doute, rougeaude, ahurie, les tambours, par le monde désira connaître et, collant ses deux.

copyrightOwners.description:
Copyright Owner

`Rights Information`

Enter the owner or owners of the copyright in the licensed image

Serves to identify the rights holder/s for the image. The Copyright Owner, Image Creator and Licensor may be the same or different entities.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#copyright-owner](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#copyright-owner)

countryName.description:
Country (legacy)

`Location`

Enter the name of the country pictured in this image

This is a detail of a location with blurred semantics as it does not clearly indicate whether it is the location in the image or the location the photo was taken - which can be different. Two more concise properties are available in IPTC Extension with Location Created and Location Shown in the Image.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#country-legacy](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#country-legacy)

countryCode.description:
Country Code (legacy)

`Location`

Enter the 2 or 3 letter ISO 3166 Country Code of the Country pictured in this image

This is a detail of a location with blurred semantics as it does not clearly indicate whether it is the location in the image or the location the photo was taken - which can be different. Two more concise properties are available in IPTC Extension with Location Created and Location Shown in the Image.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#country-code-legacy](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#country-code-legacy)

creatorNames.description:
Creator

`Rights Information`

Enter the name of the person that created this image

The creator can be expressed in a more controlled way using the "Image Creator" of PLUS  in the IPTC Extension additionally. It is the user's responsibility to keep the values of the IPTC Core and the PLUS fields in sync.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#creator](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#creator)

creatorContactInfo.description:
Creator's Contact Info

`Rights Information`

The IPTC Extension Licensor fields should be used instead of these Creator's Contact Info fields if you are using IPTC Extension fields. If the creator is also the licensor his or her contact information should be provided in the Licensor fields.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#creator's-contact-info](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#creator's-contact-info)

jobtitle.description:
Creator's jobtitle

`Rights Information`

Enter the Job Title of the person listed in the Creator field

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#creator's-jobtitle](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#creator's-jobtitle)

creditLine.description:
Credit Line

`Rights Information`

Enter who should be credited when this image is published

Note 1: For more formal identifications of the creator or the owner of the copyrights of this image other rights properties may be used. 
Note 2: This property was named "Credit" by the IIM metadata, then it was renamed to "Provider" in IPTC Core 1.0. In IPTC Core 1.1. it has been renamed to "Credit Line" as the field is used for this purpose by many users.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#credit-line](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#credit-line)
creditLine.example: All rights reserved. Duchess: 'and the moral of that is--"Be what you mean,' the March Hare took.

aboutCvTerms.description:
CV-Term About Image

`General Image Content`

Enter one or more topics, themes or entities the image is about, each one expressed by a term from a Controlled Vocabulary

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#cv-term-about-image](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#cv-term-about-image)

dataMining.description:
Data Mining

`Rights Information`

Regional laws applying to an asset may prohibit, constrain, or allow data mining for certain purposes (such as search indexing or research), and may overrule the value selected for this property. Similarly, the absence of a prohibition does not indicate that the asset owner grants permission for data mining or any other use of an asset.   +
The prohibition “Prohibited except for search engine indexing” only permits data mining by search engines available to the public to identify the URL for an asset and its associated data (for the purpose of assisting the public in navigating to the URL for the asset), and prohibits all other uses, such as AI/ML training.  +
The PLUS link:#other-constraints[Other Constraints] property is human readable. The IPTC properties link:#embedded-encoded-rights-expression[Embedded Encoded Rights Expression] and link:#linked-encoded-rights-expression[Linked Encoded Rights Expression] are machine readable.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#data-mining](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#data-mining)
enum: Prohibited except for search engine indexing

dateCreated.description:
Date Created

`Administrative Details`

Enter the Date the image was taken

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#date-created](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#date-created)

description.description:
Description

`General Image Content`

Enter a "caption" describing the who, what, and why of what is happening in this image, this might include names of people, and/or their role in the action that is taking place within the image

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#description](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#description)

example.en: Dormouse is gay as the rosetree; for, you please! "William the air. Even the fire, stirring the.
example.fr: Quel jugement? La salle des joujoux. Berthe fût trop lourde et il acceptait aussitôt, sous les.

captionWriter.description:
Description Writer

`Administrative Details`

Enter the name of the person(s) involved in writing, editing or correcting the Description, Alt Text (Accessibility), or Extended Description (Accessibility) of the image, separated by commas

Multiple description writers can be given. May have to be separated by a comma in the user interface.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#description-writer](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#description-writer)

digitalImageGuid.description:
Digital Image GUID

`Administrative Details`

If an ID already exists, don't change - otherwise enter a globally unique identifier for this digital image

The identifier will probably be generated by the technical means of an imaging device or software and should be applied to the digital image file as early as possible in its life cycle. This identifier does not identify any pictured content, particularly in case of a scan of non-digital images, only this digital representation.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#digital-image-guid](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#digital-image-guid)

digitalSourceType.description:
Digital Source Type

`Administrative Details`

Select one of the values for identifying the type of the source of the digital image from the controlled vocabulary

Please check the Digital Source Type NewsCodes vocabulary, it was updated in 2022.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#digital-source-type](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#digital-source-type)

embdEncRightsExprs.description:
Embedded Encoded Rights Expression

`Licensing Use`

Shows an encoded rights expression. These values cannot be changed by metadata panels

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#embedded-encoded-rights-expression](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#embedded-encoded-rights-expression)

eventId.description:
Event Identifier

`Other Things Shown`

Enter one or more identifiers of the event where this image was taken

The URL/URI of a persistent calendar showing this event can be used.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#event-identifier](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#event-identifier)

eventName.description:
Event Name

`Other Things Shown`

Enter the name or description of the event where this image was taken

Examples are: a press conference, dedication ceremony, etc. If this is a sub-event of a larger event both can be provided by the field: e.g. "XXXIII Olympic Summer Games (Paris): opening ceremony". Unplanned events could be named by this property too.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#event-name](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#event-name)

example.en: Alice and they couldn't help of that one side will hear the best of life! I find her head, she.
example.fr: Emma!» Son cou tendu, comme de Madame. Pour lui prodiguer au bout de débauches, pleine d'espoir.

extDescrAccessibility.description:
Extended Description (Accessibility)

`General Image Content`

Enter the text describing the appearance of an image from a visual perspective, focusing on relevant details that further describe the meaning and purpose of the image

This property should not be confused with the IPTC property Description/Caption, which is the who, what, when, where, why, how of an image. This property can be combined with Alt Text (Accessibility) if and when a brief description is not sufficient to convey the purpose and meaning of an image. It should not repeat the information in the Alt Text (Accessibility) property. It is required for conformance with the W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#extended-description-accessibility](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#extended-description-accessibility)

example.en: Cheshire Cat, and the White Rabbit blew three gardeners, oblong and raised himself as soon.
example.fr: Une fois fort bien que Bournisien résigné à marcher sur ses genoux. -- Où est allé, c'est qu'il.

headline.description:
Headline

`General Image Content`

Enter a brief publishable synopsis or summary of the contents of the image

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#headline](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#headline)
headline.example: Gryphon, 'that they WOULD go with Edgar Atheling to meet William and offer him.

imageCreators.description:
Image Creator

`Rights Information`

Enter details about the creator or creators of this image

The creator can be additionally expressed in free-text using the IPTC Core Creator field. In many countries, the Image Creator must be attributed in association with any use of the image. The Image Creator, Copyright Owner, Image Supplier and Licensor may be the same or different entities.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#image-creator](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#image-creator)

registryEntries.description:
Image Registry Entry

`Administrative Details`

Enter IDs for this image and the registry issuing the image ID

Typically an id from a registry is negotiated and applied after the creation of the digital image.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#image-registry-entry](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#image-registry-entry)

suppliers.description:
Image Supplier

`Licensing Use`

Enter the identifier for the most recent supplier of this image - note that this might not be the creator or owner of the image

For identifying the supplier either a well known and/or registered company name or a URL of the company's web site may be used. 
This property succeeds the Provider property of IPTC Core 1.0 by its semantics as that Provider was renamed to Credit Line.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#image-supplier](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#image-supplier)

imageSupplierImageId.description:
Image Supplier Image ID

`Licensing Use`

Enter the unique identifier created by the image supplier

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#image-supplier-image-id](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#image-supplier-image-id)

instructions.description:
Instructions

`Administrative Details`

Enter information about embargoes, or other restrictions not covered by the Rights Usage field

The Instructions may include any of the following: embargoes (NewsMagazines OUT) and other restrictions not covered by the "Rights Usage Terms" field; information regarding the original means of capture (scanning notes, colourspace info) or other specific text information that the user may need for accurate reproduction; additional permissions required when publishing; credits for publishing if they exceed the IIM length of the credit field

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#instructions](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#instructions)
instructions.example: Mock Turtle replied; 'and then the Mock Turtle. 'Certainly not!' said Alice in.

intellectualGenre.description:
Intellectual Genre (legacy)

`General Image Content`

Enter a term to describe the nature of the image in terms of its intellectual or journalistic characteristics

Note on "legacy": the Intellectual Genre can be expressed in a more controlled way using the "Genre" property of the IPTC Extension, IPTC recommends using it.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#intellectual-genre-legacy](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#intellectual-genre-legacy)

jobid.description:
Job Id

`Administrative Details`

Enter a number or identifier needed for workflow control or tracking

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#job-id](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#job-id)

keywords.description:
Keywords

`General Image Content`

Enter any number of keywords, terms or phrases to express the subject and other aspects of the content of the image.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#keywords](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#keywords)

licensors.description:
Licensor

`Licensing Use`

Enter the person or company that should be contacted for obtaining a license for this image

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#licensor](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#licensor)

linkedEncRightsExprs.description:
Linked  Encoded Rights Expression

`Licensing Use`

Enter the details of a linked rights expression

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#linked--encoded-rights-expression](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#linked--encoded-rights-expression)

locationCreated.description:
Location Created

`Location`

Enter the details about a location where this image was created

If the location in the image is different from the location the photo was taken the IPTC Extension property Location Shown in the Image should be used.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#location-created](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#location-created)

locationsShown.description:
Location Shown in the Image

`Location`

Enter the details about a location which is shown in this image

If the location the image was taken in is different from this location the property Location Created should be used too.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#location-shown-in-the-image](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#location-shown-in-the-image)

maxAvailHeight.description:
Max Avail Height

`Administrative Details`

Enter the maximum available height in pixels of the original photo from which this photo has been derived by downsizing

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#max-avail-height](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#max-avail-height)

maxAvailWidth.description:
Max Avail Width

`Administrative Details`

Enter the maximum available width in pixels of the original photo from which this photo has been derived by downsizing

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#max-avail-width](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#max-avail-width)

minorModelAgeDisclosure.description:
Minor Model Age Disclosure

`Persons Shown`

Enter the age of the youngest model pictured in this image, at the time that this image was made

This age should not be displayed to the public on open web portals and the like. But it may be used by image repositories in a B2B enviroment.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#minor-model-age-disclosure](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#minor-model-age-disclosure)

modelAges.description:
Model Age

`Persons Shown`

Enter the age of the human model(s) at the time this image was made

The user should be aware of any legal implications of providing ages for young models. Ages below 18 years should not be included.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#model-age](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#model-age)

modelReleaseDocuments.description:
Model Release Id

`Persons Shown`

Enter an identifier for each Model Release

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#model-release-id](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#model-release-id)

modelReleaseStatus.description:
Model Release Status

`Persons Shown`

Select one of the values for summarising the availability and scope of model releases authorising usage of the likenesses of persons appearing in the photograph

It is recommended to apply the PLUS controlled value Unlimited Model Releases (MR-UMR) very carefully and to check the wording of the model release thoroughly before applying it.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#model-release-status](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#model-release-status)

organisationInImageNames.description:
Name of Organisation Featured in the Image

`Other Things Shown`

Enter the name of the organisation which is featured by this image

May be supplemented by values from a controlled vocabulary in the Organisation Code field.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#name-of-organisation-featured-in-the-image](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#name-of-organisation-featured-in-the-image)

externalDocs.description: Name of Organisation Featured in the Image

otherConstraints.description:
Other Constraints

`Rights Information`

Constraints may limit the scope of usage allowed

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#other-constraints](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#other-constraints)

example.en: Rabbit interrupted: 'UNimportant, of Hearts, and to have to fall right to open it; but, as they.
example.fr: Les herbes aromatiques fumaient l'air, s'étendaient de longs papiers neufs, repeindre l'escalier.

personInImageNames.description:
Person Shown in the Image

`Persons Shown`

Enter the name of the person shown in this image

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#person-shown-in-the-image](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#person-shown-in-the-image)

personsShown.description:
Person Shown in the Image with Details

`Persons Shown`

Enter details about person(s) shown in the image. It is not required to list all, just those details which can be recognized

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#person-shown-in-the-image-with-details](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#person-shown-in-the-image-with-details)

externalDocs.description: Person Shown in the Image with Details

productsShown.description:
Product Shown in the Image

`Other Things Shown`

Enter details about a product shown in the image

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#product-shown-in-the-image](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#product-shown-in-the-image)

propertyReleaseDocuments.description:
Property Release Id

`Rights Information`

Enter an identifier for each Property Release

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#property-release-id](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#property-release-id)

propertyReleaseStatus.description:
Property Release Status

`Rights Information`

Select one of the values for summarising the availability and scope of property releases authorising usage of the properties appearing in the photograph

It is recommended to apply the value PR-UPR very carefully and to check the wording of the property release thoroughly before applying it.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#property-release-status](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#property-release-status)

provinceState.description:
Province or State (legacy)

`Location`

Enter the name of the province or state pictured in this image

rbShape.description:
Boundary Shape

The applicable shapes are:

* _rectangle_ = a rectangle as shape of the boundary, the shape of a square is included 
* _circle_ = a circle as the shape of the boundary 
* _polygon_ = any shape with edges, except a rectangle, including a single point (using 1 vertex) and a line (using 2 vertices). The edges between a vertex and the next one in the sequence set the shape, the last edge is the one from the last vertex in the sequence to the first vertex in the sequence.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#boundary-shape](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#boundary-shape)

rbUnit.description:

* _pixel_ = A pixel of a digital image setting an absolute value 
* _relative_ = Relative part of the size of an image along the x- or the y-axis. The range of the value is from 0 to 1 representing the proportion of the full size of an image along the x-axis or the y-axis.

[https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#boundary-measuring-unit](https://www.iptc.org/std/photometadata/specification/IPTC-PhotoMetadata#boundary-measuring-unit)
